## renderer notes (render_r1.md) — judgement
1. Business payment-hold rate when the held period's fee has not settled: real source openness (rule says "before the date the fee of that billing period settled"; compute treats an unsettled fee as `'9999-12-31'`, i.e. still inside the hold). The KB carries the source wording and may not close it → **src** (src1). Not reached by either task.
2. One-factor quantities (units on this return, return/refund date) filed as plain bindings: no normative effect; their defining sentences are factor-ladder sentences and the documents carry them in the factor documents; computation documents are complete → **no defect**.
3. Zero refund cannot be booked: confirmed in task_tools.py (`_Fmt.money(refund_amount_usd) <= 0` → Error) and the schemas ("positive number"), while both refund rules floor at zero ("never below zero"). A Business closure whose recovery meets the closure core, or an Annual refund floored at 0.00, has no completing action in the visible materials; same class: a Business earning reduced to 0.00 by the twelve-month cap ("nothing posts") against the prerequisite "…has its Northgate Cash earning on the membership's ledger, when that line earns Northgate Cash" (does a capped line "earn"?), with the posting tool refusing 0.00. Faithfully carried by the KB → **src** (src2). Not reached by either task.
